content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Bhilai Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Bhilai to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai) for various project staff positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under IIT Bhilai Project Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for different project staff roles including civil, general administration, and agriculture domains.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 07-10-2026 up to 05:30 PM via the provided Google form link.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these project staff posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between Rs. 20,000 and Rs. 32,000 per month depending on the post and project guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required for General Admin posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Staff (General Admin) post must hold a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, making the application process free of cost for all interested candidates.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The offline trade test and/or interview is scheduled to be held on 09-10-2026 starting at 09:30 AM at IIT Bhilai.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job location for these positions?
faq.answer: The job locations include IIT Bhilai, Rajnandgaon, and Mohla-Manpur in Chhattisgarh, with extensive travel required to project districts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract for these project staff roles?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for a period of up to one year, which may be extended based on project requirements, funding, and performance.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates apply for IIT Bhilai Project Staff Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by filling out the designated Google form link provided in the official notification before the deadline.
